name: Connecteam
summary: All-in-one app for managing deskless teams. Scheduling, time clock, tasks, training and team chat for hourly and frontline workforces.
best_for: deskless and frontline teams (shift work, field crews) that need scheduling, a time clock and comms in one app, on the free-for-10 plan
skip_if: your whole team sits at desks with email and Slack — this is built for the frontline, and a general PM tool fits an office better
honest_knock: The free-for-10 plan is one of the most generous in the category, but the three-hub structure means costs can stack if you need all of them — price the specific hubs you'll actually use, not the full bundle.

pricing.entry_price_terms: per month billed yearly ($35 monthly), covers first 30 users
pricing.notes: (re-verified 2026-10-03 on their own pricing page, USD) The free tier is real and not a trial: the Small Business Plan is $0 for life, covers up to 10 users and includes all hubs and features. Above that you buy per hub — Operations, Communications or HR & Skills — and each hub carries a flat base price covering the first 30 users, plus a per-user surcharge only from user 31 onward. Billed yearly that base is $29/mo at Basic, $49 at Advanced and $99 at Expert; billed monthly it is $35, $59 and $119. The surcharge is where the hubs diverge: on the yearly plans Operations adds $0.80, $2.50 and $4.20 per extra user a month, while Communications and HR & Skills add $0.50, $1.50 and $3.00. Quoting only the per-user rate understates a small team's bill, because a shop of 30 or fewer pays the flat base either way. Price it per hub you will actually switch on, not per user. Re-read on 3 October 2026 with every figure unchanged; the yearly toggle is now labelled "save 18%", and the 14-day trial still needs no credit card.
